csp.text: The Cult of Rimewind, led by Heidar, tries to undo the Thaw, and on Heidar's advice Gendrin orders spells that temporarily halt it and plunge the continent back into winter.
The cult reanimates Phyrexian war-beasts, and when Lovisa Coldeyes' Balduvians storm Rimewind, Heidar activates them, causing a massacre and rampage.
Yavimayan shamans destroy the Phyrexians, and Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists, and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
